He wears modest ivory robes, a deep navy mantle with restrained gold edging, no crown. He holds a reed pen beside an open handwritten codex and a rolled parchment. Realistic painterly detail, rich materials, readable silhouettes, same art direction as a premium gold-framed Civ V civilization pack. The open pages have only subtle unreadable manuscript strokes.
